messages:
Maya R: Heads up — after yesterday's kernel swap for Mistral-7B we are seeing tail latency spikes on long contexts (>= 4k). Not huge QPS impact but 95/99p up ~2.2x in canary.
Kevin H: ugh. Any obvious culprit? kernel changed to tiled-attn_v2 + new tiling heuristics right?
Maya R: yes. We changed kernel + adjusted batching window to favor throughput. Profiling points at KV cache churn and a bunch of small CUDA memcpy ops during decode on longer sequences.
Jin Park: can you paste the profiler snapshot?
Maya R: dropping snippet from perf-bot: 
```
perf-bot: profile 1799999999/mistral-canary-3
Top stacks:
  tiled_attn_v2::run -> memcpy_async (0.42s)
  kv_cache::write_back -> memcpy_sync (0.35s)
  scheduler::pack_batches -> concat (0.18s)
KV cache write_back count increased x3 vs baseline.
```
Alex T: that memcpy_async spike smells like more frequent KV evictions + smaller batches -> more shuffle. Did batching heuristics reduce prefix coalescing?
Maya R: yes, new batching_window = 50ms instead of 80ms for canary to reduce latency avg. That hurt prefix coalescing for long sessions.
Kevin H: we toggled quantization path too for that kernel, right? int8 path enabled for canary models?
Maya R: int8 was enabled as part of the bundle. But the primary offender in trace is repeated KV serializations, not compute.
Jin Park: two-pronged: 1) rollback batching_window to 80ms in canary for Mistral-7B 2) revert tiled_attn_v2 kernel only for long-context variants (pin older kernel for sequences > 2k). Canary rollback first.
Alex T: agree. Also add a short-lived flag that forces KV prefetch coalescing (experimental) to validate if memcpy pattern goes away.
perf-bot: added alert: mistral-canary-3 latency 95p > 320ms for 10% of requests. Tickets: INF-4123
Maya R: I'm going to roll batching_window back on canary now and schedule a kernel pin for long contexts. Will also run replayed eval (eval-suite/rope-long-contexts) against both kernels.
SRE Oncall: noted, notify customers on dedicated clusters if we see sustained regression.
Kevin H: good. If revert doesn't fix, we should consider disabling int8 for canary until we untangle KV layout changes.
Jin Park: agreed. Also capture meminfo at peak and include CUDA stream timings. I'll add trace hook.
Alex T: can we get a flamegraph? If memcpy is dominating, we might be able to batch memcopies or change KV layout to be GPU-native (avoid host roundtrips).
Maya R: next steps in INF-4123: (1) rollback batching_window on canary (done) (2) pin kernel for long-context models (scheduled) (3) run replay eval and attach flamegraphs (4) if still bad -> disable int8 + try KV layout tweak.
Kevin H: thanks. Keep the channel updated. :thumbsup:
Maya R: will update with trial results in ~30m.
perf-bot: update INF-4123 -> state: investigating
Maya R: quick update: after batching rollback 95p dropped ~35% in canary within 5m. Kernel pin scheduled for tonight's deploy window.
Jin Park: nice signal. If we keep rollbacks limited to canary it's safe. We'll prepare a gradual canary sweep to validate the kernel change once we redesign KV write path.
Alex T: capture a diff of kernel-build flags between tiled_attn_v2 and older kernel and add to the ticket. Might be an ABI change causing extra copies.
Maya R: copying that into INF-4123. Thanks team.
